metaDescription: UPL Pn 4 peanut is a peanut variety. 105 to 110 days to harvest, 2.2 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: UPL Pn 4 is a registered peanut variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1978. It takes 105 to 110 days from sowing to harvest, with 2.25 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Pn 4 peanut
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPL Pn 4 peanut takes 105 to 110 days from sowing to harvest. That is 6.2 days longer than the average of the 26 peanut varieties with a day count, 101.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 2.25 t/ha beats the average of its group, 1.85. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit peanut fields most often: [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant UPL Pn 4 peanut
Mani needs loose, well drained soil to fill its pods. Pick a variety by seed size for your buyer, and one rated against rust and leaf spot for the wet season.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 105 to 110 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 2.25 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPL Pn 4?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
